item.title: Wanwan, Moomoo, Usausa, Koon!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Moe Tamago Soft
  • 発売日: 2007-11-30
  • スコア: 6.35/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: わんわん、もーもー、うさうさ、こーん！
  • 英語名: Wanwan, Moomoo, Usausa, Koon!

あらすじ

The main character starts working at the Swallowtail, a sweets shop, because his mother, who is the owner of the shop, gets ill. There are his old friend, Saki, and a patissier, Shiera. And his friends, Tamamo and Mikoto, join them. One day, he finds that he’s got a special power that what he imagines happens in the real world. He doesn’t know what’s happened to him, but he thinks about this and that….

item.title: Futago to Heaven!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Moe Tamago Soft
  • 発売日: 2006-10-27
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふたごとへぶん！
  • 英語名: Futago to Heaven!

あらすじ

The main character is Minoru from a rich family. His father runs a high school and he belongs to it. He is supposed to have a job as a manager of the dorm for female students after graduation but the manager suddenly quits and he takes over it. “The dorm is full of girls!” Girls come to the manager room night after night to have sex with him and his full of sex life starts…
